examples: You can't just ignore the problem and hope it goes away on its own.
نمی‌توانی مشکل را نادیده بگیری و امید داشته باشی خودش حل شود.
She chose to ignore his rude comment and continued with her presentation.
او تصمیم گرفت نظر بی‌ادبانه او را نادیده بگیرد و ارائه‌اش را ادامه دهد.
Drivers should never ignore a flashing warning light on the dashboard.
راننده‌ها هرگز نباید چراغ هشدار چشمک‌زن روی داشبورد را نادیده بگیرند.
miniContext: It's tempting to ignore small warning signs, whether in a relationship, a car engine, or a budget. A manager who chooses to ignore employee complaints often ends up with a bigger problem later. Doctors warn patients not to ignore symptoms that last longer than a week. Sometimes the easiest short-term choice is to ignore a problem, but it rarely makes the problem disappear.

examples: Please sign the document before you leave the office today.
لطفاً قبل از ترک دفتر امروز، سند را امضا کنید.
Researchers carefully document every step of their experiment in a lab notebook.
پژوهشگران هر مرحله از آزمایش خود را با دقت در دفترچه آزمایشگاه مستند می‌کنند.
The lawyer asked for an official document proving ownership of the land.
وکیل سندی رسمی برای اثبات مالکیت زمین درخواست کرد.
miniContext: A document can be anything from a simple letter to an official government record. Businesses are required to document important decisions in case questions come up later. Historians rely on old letters and photographs as documents that reveal how people once lived. Keeping a careful document of agreements, whether written or digital, protects everyone involved.

examples: The castle has stood on this hill for more than a century.
این قلعه بیش از یک قرن است که بر این تپه ایستاده است.
Scientists in the twenty-first century have made huge advances in medicine.
دانشمندان در قرن بیست‌ویکم پیشرفت‌های بزرگی در پزشکی داشته‌اند.
This painting has survived nearly a century of wars, floods, and fires.
این نقاشی تقریباً یک قرن جنگ، سیل و آتش‌سوزی را پشت سر گذاشته است.
miniContext: A century is a period of one hundred years, long enough to see entire ways of life change completely. Technology that seemed impossible at the start of a century, like instant global communication, can feel ordinary by its end. Families sometimes keep letters or photographs that have survived nearly a century. Looking back a century helps people appreciate how quickly the world can transform.

examples: Learning a new language as an adult can be a real challenge.
یادگیری یک زبان جدید در بزرگسالی می‌تواند چالش واقعی باشد.
The coach decided to challenge his players with a tougher training schedule.
مربی تصمیم گرفت بازیکنانش را با برنامه تمرینی سخت‌تری به چالش بکشد.
She didn't hesitate to challenge the committee's decision during the meeting.
او بدون تردید تصمیم کمیته را در طول جلسه به چالش کشید.
miniContext: A challenge can be a difficult task that tests someone's skill, or an open call to compete. Moving to a new country presents a real challenge, from learning the language to understanding local customs. A good teacher knows how to challenge students without overwhelming them. Facing a challenge head-on, rather than avoiding it, is usually how people grow the most.

examples: Always check the source of information before sharing it online.
همیشه قبل از به اشتراک گذاشتن اطلاعات آنلاین، منبع آن را بررسی کنید.
The river's source is a small spring high in the mountains.
منبع این رودخانه یک چشمه کوچک در ارتفاعات کوهستان است.
Solar power is becoming a major source of energy around the world.
انرژی خورشیدی در حال تبدیل شدن به یکی از منابع اصلی انرژی در جهان است.
miniContext: A source is where something originally comes from, whether it's information, water, or income. Journalists must protect the identity of a source who shares sensitive information. Rivers often begin at a source high in the mountains, far from where they eventually reach the sea. Checking more than one source before believing a claim is a basic habit of careful thinking.

examples: After reviewing all the evidence, the jury had to conclude that he was innocent.
بعد از بررسی تمام شواهد، هیئت منصفه مجبور شد نتیجه بگیرد که او بی‌گناه است.
Scientists concluded that the new drug was safe after years of testing.
دانشمندان بعد از سال‌ها آزمایش نتیجه گرفتند که داروی جدید بی‌خطر است.
The speaker decided to conclude her speech with a short personal story.
سخنران تصمیم گرفت سخنرانی‌اش را با یک داستان کوتاه شخصی به پایان برساند.
miniContext: To conclude means to reach a final decision or bring something to an end after careful consideration. After weeks of testimony, the jury had enough evidence to conclude that the defendant was guilty. A good essay doesn't just stop; it should conclude with a clear summary of the main argument. Researchers are cautious about rushing to conclude anything before all the data has been analyzed.

examples: The evidence against him was undeniable, so the court quickly reached a verdict.
شواهد علیه او انکارناپذیر بود، به همین دلیل دادگاه سریع به رأی رسید.
There is an undeniable connection between regular exercise and better sleep.
ارتباطی انکارناپذیر بین ورزش منظم و خواب بهتر وجود دارد.
Her talent for painting was undeniable, even to her harshest critics.
استعداد او در نقاشی حتی برای سخت‌گیرترین منتقدانش هم انکارناپذیر بود.
miniContext: Something undeniable is so clearly true that no reasonable person could argue against it. The photographs provided undeniable proof that the bridge had been damaged before the storm. Her skill as a musician was undeniable after just a few notes. When evidence becomes undeniable, even skeptics eventually have to accept the facts.

examples: This recipe will lack flavor if you forget to add salt.
اگر نمک اضافه کردن را فراموش کنی، این دستور غذا کمبود طعم خواهد داشت.
Many rural schools lack the basic equipment that city schools take for granted.
بسیاری از مدارس روستایی کمبود تجهیزات اولیه‌ای دارند که مدارس شهری آن‌ها را بدیهی می‌دانند.
He seemed to lack confidence during his first few weeks on the job.
به نظر می‌رسید او در چند هفته اول کارش اعتمادبه‌نفس کافی نداشت.
miniContext: A shortage, or lack, of something important can cause serious problems even when everything else is going well. A diet that lacks enough vitamins can leave a person feeling tired and weak all the time. Many small towns lack reliable internet access, which makes remote work difficult. Recognizing exactly what a plan or a person might lack is often the first step toward fixing it.

examples: There isn't a single coffee shop in the vicinity of the office.
در محدوده اطراف دفتر حتی یک کافی‌شاپ هم وجود ندارد.
Police searched the vicinity of the park for any sign of the missing dog.
پلیس محدوده اطراف پارک را برای یافتن نشانی از سگ گمشده جست‌وجو کرد.
Several schools are located in the immediate vicinity of the new subway station.
چند مدرسه در محدوده نزدیک ایستگاه جدید مترو واقع شده‌اند.
miniContext: The vicinity of a place is simply the area close to it or surrounding it. When searching for a lost pet, it helps to check the immediate vicinity of where it was last seen. Real estate prices often rise sharply in the vicinity of a new subway station. Staying in the vicinity of a trusted hospital can bring peace of mind to new parents.

examples: He could barely control his rage after hearing the unfair decision.
او بعد از شنیدن آن تصمیم ناعادلانه به‌سختی توانست خشم شدیدش را کنترل کند.
The wildfire continued to rage across the hillside for three more days.
آتش‌سوزی سه روز دیگر هم با شدت در سراسر دامنه تپه ادامه داشت.
Fans began to rage on social media after the team's referee controversy.
طرفداران بعد از جنجال داوری تیم، در شبکه‌های اجتماعی با خشم واکنش نشان دادند.
miniContext: Rage is an intense, often uncontrollable anger that can take over a person's actions. He felt a surge of rage when he learned his idea had been stolen without credit. Storms can also rage, with wind and rain hitting a coastline for days without pause. Learning to manage rage, rather than suppress it completely, is considered healthier in the long run.

examples: She collects miniature models of famous landmarks from around the world.
او مدل‌های مینیاتوری از بناهای تاریخی معروف سراسر جهان را جمع‌آوری می‌کند.
The children built a miniature village out of cardboard and paint for the school project.
بچه‌ها برای پروژه مدرسه یک دهکده مینیاتوری از کارتن و رنگ ساختند.
Inside the glass case was a miniature replica of the entire solar system.
داخل جعبه شیشه‌ای یک نسخه مینیاتوری از کل منظومه شمسی قرار داشت.
miniContext: Something miniature is a much smaller version of the real thing, often built with great detail. Model railway enthusiasts spend years building miniature towns complete with tiny trees and streetlights. A dollhouse is essentially a miniature version of a full-sized home. Miniature versions of famous landmarks are popular souvenirs for tourists around the world.

examples: It's hard to resist fresh bread straight out of the oven.
سخت است در برابر نان تازه که تازه از فر بیرون آمده مقاومت کرد.
The old fortress was built to resist even the heaviest cannon fire.
این قلعه قدیمی طوری ساخته شده بود که در برابر سنگین‌ترین شلیک‌های توپ هم مقاومت کند.
Workers resisted the new policy by organizing a peaceful protest outside the factory.
کارگران با برگزاری یک تحصن مسالمت‌آمیز بیرون کارخانه در برابر سیاست جدید مقاومت کردند.
miniContext: To resist means to fight against something or refuse to give in to it. Even trained soldiers found it difficult to resist the freezing cold during the siege. A good raincoat is designed to resist water without trapping heat inside. Customers sometimes can't resist a sale, even when they don't really need the item.
